# Changelog

## 2.1.316

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
- Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself
- Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted

## 2.1.315

- Fixed the status line flickering in narrow terminals
- Improved startup time

## 2.1.314

- Added `/doctor --json`

## 2.1.309

- Fixed a crash on resume
